Sloan-Swartz Centers 2012 Annual Meeting

Date: June 27–29, 2012
Location: San Diego Supercomputer Center, UC San Diego
La Jolla, California

Welcome to the Sloan-Swartz 2012 Annual Meeting Website

The Sloan-Swartz Centers Summer Meetings began in 1995. They have played a catalytic role in advancing the field of Computational Neuroscience. They have enabled Sloan and Swartz grantees to meet each other and learn about theoretical and computational work at other Centers. The meeting will bring together participants from the 11 Centers, and distinguished invited speakers.

List of centers: https://www.theswartzfoundation.org/research.asp

Hosted by the Sloan-Swartz Center for Theoretical Neurobiology at the Salk Institute and the Swartz Center for Computational Neuroscience at UC San Diego

Invited Speakers

John Doyle (Caltech, Pasadena, CA)
Control systems

Carl Petersen (Ecole Polytechnique Federale de Lausanne, Switzerland)
Perception and learning mechanisms

Astrid Prinz (Emory, Atlanta, GA)
Pattern generation and homeostatic regulation

Sascha du Lac (Salk Institute)
Vestibulo-ocular reflex learning

Charles Schroeder (Nathan S. Kline Institute, Orangeburg, NY)
Primate sensorimotor processing
